message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (red, yellow, green, blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two action cards: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Four Wild cards and four Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points over multiple rounds. Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Gameplay** | • Players take turns clockwise.
• On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard card, or a Wild card.
• If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction (in 2‑player games it acts like Skip).
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: the player who missed it must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands: numbered cards = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild cards = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches 500 points. | **Optional Variations** | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative total unless they can counter with another stackable card. | | **No Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played freely without the “no matching color” rule. | | **Custom Decks** | Use themed decks (e.g., Uno Attack) which add special mechanics such as automatic draws triggered by a button. | That’s the core of Uno! Feel free to tweak or add house rules to keep the game fresh.
